text:
```yaml
name: Commands Workflow

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      command:
        description: 'The command to run'
        required: true
        type: string
        default: '/makerelease'

jobs:
  run-command:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run command
      id: run_command
      run: |
        case ${{ github.event.inputs.command }} in
          /makerelease)
            npm run makerelease
            ;;
          /othercommand)
            # Add your logic for /othercommand here
            echo "Running /othercommand"
            ;;
          *)
            echo "Unknown command"
            exit 1
            ;;
        esac
```
